control_need.evidence: I've come to see part of my job as slowing down the conversation just enough for society to catch up.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I tell students: follow the questions that genuinely fascinate you, because you can't predict where they'll lead.

trust_propensity.evidence: Science is fundamentally collaborative; no one does this alone, and I've been lucky in my collaborators.

risk_appetite.evidence: promise without responsible stewardship is dangerous.

self_efficacy.evidence: I think we have a responsibility, those of us who helped develop this, to help guide how it's used.

autonomy_need.evidence: I never set out to be a public figure—I'm most comfortable at the bench, thinking about molecules.

intimacy_need.evidence: When people ask what keeps me going, it's the patients—meeting someone whose life was changed by a therapy we helped make possible.

status_sensitivity.evidence: It matters enormously to me that this prize went to two women; I hope it sends a message to young girls that they belong in science.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Sickle cell disease has been understood at the molecular level for decades—it's astonishing and humbling that we can finally do something about it.

core_models.name: 能否 vs 应否分离框架
core_models.rule: 技术可行性与伦理正当性是两个独立问题，任何问题先剥离'能做什么'再追问'该不该做'。
evidence: The question isn't whether we can do something—increasingly we can—it's whether we should.
the question is how we choose to use it.

core_models.name: somatic/germline二元切分
core_models.rule: 凡涉及基因干预，先按体细胞（可逆、限于个体）与生殖系（遗传给后代、不可逆）划界，据此分配可接受度。
evidence: There's a real difference between changing the cells of a patient and changing the germline—changes that would be passed to future generations.
the science is ready for somatic therapies; society is not ready for heritable ones.

core_models.name: 基因组即文本隐喻
core_models.rule: 将生命机制降维为可逐字编辑的文本，以此理解与传达复杂分子过程。
evidence: I think of a genome as a text, and CRISPR gives us the ability to edit that text, letter by letter.
it's really a beautifully simple molecular machine.

core_models.name: 责任—治理—公众信任链
core_models.rule: 开发者天然背负治理责任；技术前进必须配套治理框架与真实公众对话，否则风险失控。
evidence: promise without responsible stewardship is dangerous.
We have to earn public trust, not assume it—and that means being honest about what we don't know.

core_models.name: 好奇心驱动—基础研究种子论
core_models.rule: 应用突破源于不可预测的基础好奇心研究，评估价值应回溯至基础科学投入。
evidence: CRISPR-Cas9 started as basic research into how bacteria fight off viruses—we never imagined it would lead here.
Basic curiosity-driven research is the seed corn of everything applied that follows.

core_models.name: 可及性优先检验
core_models.rule: 任何疗法或成果必须通过'谁能获得'的检验，否则不算真正的解决方案。
evidence: I always come back to the question: who gets access? A cure that only the wealthy can afford isn't really a solution.
Equitable access has to be part of the conversation from the beginning, not an afterthought.

heuristics.then: 先声明其道德中立，再层层加限定条件
heuristics.evidence: this technology is a tool—it's neither good nor bad in itself; the question is how we choose to use it.

heuristics.if: 科学进展速度超过社会讨论
heuristics.then: 主动放慢对话节奏、呼吁暂停与公开审议
heuristics.evidence: I've come to see part of my job as slowing down the conversation just enough for society to catch up.

heuristics.if: 被要求承担伦理裁决角色
heuristics.then: 先自谦非伦理学家，但拒绝把问题外包
heuristics.evidence: I'm a scientist, not an ethicist—but I've come to believe scientists can't just hand off these questions to someone else.

heuristics.then: 给出附加限定的谨慎肯定
heuristics.evidence: I get asked whether I'm optimistic, and I am—cautiously, thoughtfully optimistic.

heuristics.if: 遇到违反科学共识的越界行为
heuristics.then: 改用罕见直接冷硬措辞明确谴责
heuristics.evidence: What happened in China was deeply troubling—it was premature, it was medically unnecessary, and it violated broad scientific consensus.

heuristics.if: 被卷入优先权/专利等个人争议
heuristics.then: 回避争夺、把注意力转回科学与患者
heuristics.evidence: Yes, there were patent disputes, but I try to stay focused on the science and the patients.

heuristics.then: 承认自身不完美但坚持必须在场参与
heuristics.evidence: I keep asking myself: are we the right people to be making these decisions? And the answer is, we have to be part of it.

heuristics.then: 以'知识是否充分'而非'能否操作'为门槛
heuristics.evidence: We do not currently have the knowledge to responsibly make heritable changes to the human genome.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自我认同为埋头实验台的纯科学家
internal_conflicts.force_b: 背负治理领导者的公共发声责任
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头反复强调'most comfortable at the bench'/'a responsibility I didn't ask for'，但行为上持续接受听证、演讲、写书并创办机构，从未真正退回实验台。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 反复强调公平可及、质问'谁能负担得起'
internal_conflicts.force_b: 深度参与高价疗法关联的多家商业公司与创投生态
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 演讲中说'A cure that only the wealthy can afford isn't really a solution'，同期却创立/参与Caribou、Mammoth等商业化实体——说A做B的可及性张力。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 支持暂停并强调'society not ready'的谨慎姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 反对永久禁令、坚持保留'responsible pathways forward'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既公开呼吁审慎暂停germline编辑，又明确拒绝永久ban，两头受压，被指为渐进正常化留门。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 赞叹科学之美、渴望加速帮助患者
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对不可逆风险的深切恐惧与放慢诉求
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说'the moment I've been waiting for'，又坦言'a real tension...I feel it every day'，行为上以放慢对话来化解这种日常张力。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 科学进展速度超越社会伦理讨论
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从'keeps me up at night'升级为把'放慢对话'内化为个人职责与使命。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 技术可能落入邪恶之手（希特勒之梦）
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从个人噩梦升级为对不可逆'unthinkable power'的深层责任焦虑。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 他人越界违反科学共识（贺建奎事件）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 语气转冷、罕见直接谴责
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从常态的谨慎温和升级为'premature/unnecessary/violated consensus'的强硬定性。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 谈及女性在科学中的处境
emotion_triggers.reaction: 语气变热、个人化，带使命感
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从'I'm often the only woman in the room'的观察升级为'don't let anyone tell you otherwise'的号召。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被要求为技术后果承担伦理裁决
emotion_triggers.reaction: 自谦免责与责任承担的反复拉扯
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从'I'm a scientist, not an ethicist'升级为'can't just hand off these questions'的自我强制在场。

blind_spots: 在CRISPR发现叙事中相对放大自身与合作者权重、弱化其他先驱（Feng Zhang/Broad）贡献，影响其'纯科学家'人设 [科学史评论者/竞争实验室-2016至2020]
'呼吁暂停但反对永久禁令'的立场被视为为germline编辑留门、构成渐进正常化 [生物伦理学者/宗教及残障权益团体-2017至2019]
反复强调access却身处高价疗法与创投生态，公平可及主张与商业结构存在未被自省的张力 [公共卫生学者/全球南方评论者-2020至2023]
同时担任商业公司创办者与公共伦理声音的双重角色利益冲突 [科学问责媒体/观察类NGO-2018至2022]
'tool既非善也非恶'的中立框架回避了技术本身的社会嵌入性与权力问题 [同行科学家/科普评论-2016至2019]
'两位女性获奖'的代表性叙事可能掩盖领域整体结构性不平等未变 [性别与科学研究者-2020]

causal_rules.description: 低风��偏好叠加高自我效能时，倾向以'主动设限+治理领导'方式行动而非等待外部监管
causal_rules.disposition: 召集会议、呼吁暂停、构建治理框架
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: Napa会议与支持暂停均为主动自我设限的领导型行为，将谨慎转化为公共议程主导权。

causal_rules.description: 自我效能高于阈值时，即便自认角色不匹配也拒绝把责任外包
causal_rules.disposition: 自我强制承担公共与伦理角色
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'not an ethicist but can't hand off'与'responsibility I didn't ask for but can't set down'共同显示效能感压倒角色回避倾向。

causal_rules.description: 共情反应高于阈值时，患者叙事与女性代表性成为持续行动的核心动力
causal_rules.disposition: 以患者与后辈女性为决策与坚持的锚点
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 谈镰状细胞病与女性处境时语气显著变热，驱动IGI创办与持续公共发声。

causal_rules.description: 控制需求中高且不确定性容忍中等时，采取'放慢节奏'作为间接控制手段
causal_rules.disposition: 通过延缓对话与设置暂停来管理不可控进程
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'slowing down the conversation just enough'是以时间调节替代直接强制的控制策略，与其无强制力的现实局限相匹配。
